answers.short: Gravity is the force that attracts objects with mass toward one another.
answers.normal: Gravity is a fundamental force that causes objects with mass to attract one another.
answers.detailed: Gravity is a fundamental interaction associated with mass and energy. Near Earth, it causes objects to accelerate toward the ground and keeps the Moon and artificial satellites in orbit.

answers.short: Physics is the science that studies matter, energy, motion, and the fundamental forces of nature.
answers.normal: Physics is a branch of science that studies matter, energy, motion, forces, space, and time.
answers.detailed: Physics is a fundamental science that seeks to understand how matter and energy behave and interact. It includes areas such as mechanics, thermodynamics, electromagnetism, relativity, and quantum physics.

answers.short: Energy is the capacity to cause change or do work.
answers.normal: Energy is the capacity of a system to do work or cause physical change.
answers.detailed: Energy is a physical quantity associated with the ability of a system to perform work or produce change. It appears in forms such as kinetic, potential, thermal, chemical, and electromagnetic energy.
